ns2:course.label: Intermediate Bamana II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of BMNA 403. Emphasis on ability to engage in reasonably fluent discourse in Bamana and comprehensive knowledge of formal grammar, and ability to read ordinary texts in standard Bamana. Participation in the language laboratory may be required. Same as AFST 404. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008: 4 hours only. Prerequisite: BMNA 403.
